title: Behavioural assay for olfactory plasticity in C. elegans
protocol: Pick about 6 adults to NGM plates seeded with bacterial strain NA22, 4 days before the assay.
Collect well-fed animals in microfuge tubes and wash 3 times with Wash buffer to remove bacteria and larval worms.
Add 100 μl of 10^-4 dilutions of odorants in water into the tubes for odorant pre-exposure.

During odorant pre-exposure, prepare assay plates by spotting 1 μl each of odorant and 0.5 μl each of 1 M sodium azide on two points at one end of the plates, and spot only sodium azide on the other side.
After 5 min of pre-exposure, add 1 ml of Wash buffer and centrifuge for 5 seconds at 100 g.
Suck animals settled at the bottom and spot about 50 animals at the center of an assay plate.
Remove excess liquid with Kimwipes and disperse the animals gently along the midline of the plates to prevent clumping.
Count the number of animals in areas A or B after 30 min.
Exclude animals that remain within 0.5 cm of the midline from counting.
Calculate the chemotaxis index as (NA – NB) / (NA + NB).
